Maria (CS): Heads-up: Sunrise customer onboarding. Need final quota, autoscale settings, and 30m focused load-run tomorrow.
Tom R.: What traffic shape? steady or bursty?
Maria (CS): Mix — steady search embeddings plus afternoon chat spikes. Expect baseline ~25k tok/s, bursts to ~95k tok/s. Renewal risk if p95 > 350ms first 72h.
Lina (Ops): Proposal: reserved 5 GPUs, autoscale min=2 max=18, warm_burst=4. Pre-warm KV for their top-40 queries 15m prior.
Priya (SE): Load plan: 5m smoke, 10m ramp to 60%, 10m ramp to 100%, 5m cool. Target p95 < 300ms.
Tom R.: Autoscale: scale_up at 72% util for 45s, scale_down at 30% for 3m, step +2, cooldown 90s. Canary 10% for 6m.
monitor-bot: Created channel #inc-1758899999-sunrise-loadtest
Lina (Ops): Ops will set throttle at 120% committed during test and enable billing alert >15%/hr.
Priya (SE): Load command for ops:
```
./stress_tool --model redwood-4x --tokens 95000 --ramp 600 --dur 900 --kv-prime top40.json
```
Maria (CS): Who owns post-test notes?
Tom R.: I'll write the report; Priya adds enablement checklist.
Maria (CS): Confirm KMS, network rules, and contact list before I notify customer.
Priya (SE): KMS ok, network rules validated.
Lina (Ops): Window confirmed 2025-07-12 14:00-14:45 UTC.
Maria (CS): Great — I'll tell Sunrise and add them to #inc-1758899999-sunrise-loadtest. Thanks all :thumbsup:
